comparableWarmCommand.limitation: Only the warm pair supports the whole-command headline; baseline-1 regenerated unrelated copied fixture stamps. Individual test durations exclude that preparation and all four normal legs passed.

regressionProof.method: After review and all document/timing assertions, disable the actual FX or Reactions track through track.update. Force the two kit exports through real Remotion so their existing route prerequisite still passes. Preserve every original pixel assertion; each test fails only at its expected rendered-output threshold. No mocks or production changes.

visualInspection: Apply Style extracted kit frames show the same normalized bars and effect. Reactions frames show the same 45%-of-frame source size and wobble. Fresh marker identities seed different allowed slot/flip draws; the size, normalized slot geometry and flip rule are preserved, rather than identical random placement across runs.

validation.normalBrowserRuns: 4 commands / 12 workflow executions passed; 2 candidate repetitions passed; no retries or timeouts changed.
validation.metadata: Vendor ffprobe counted decoded frames in all 24 normal-run movies and verified identical rate, duration, frame count and stream kinds for every output across all 4 legs.
validation.static: pnpm e2e:typecheck; pnpm exec biome check e2e/apply-style.spec.ts e2e/automation.spec.ts e2e/automation-overlays.spec.ts; git diff --check
validation.remainingLimits: Full-suite and CI timing belong to the coordinator. Existing CLAP opt-in is unaffected. The native smoke 1080p format contract remains unchanged. No total-process-tree CPU or peak-memory claim is made.
